name: ai-cli-translate
title: AI CLI Translate
description: Translate text with your local AI subscriptions through CLI tools (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI)
author: stu43005

commands.name: translate
commands.title: AI Translate
commands.subtitle: AI CLI Translate
commands.description: Translate text with a local AI CLI in a two-pane Source / Target view

preferences.name: provider
preferences.title: AI CLI Provider
preferences.description: Which locally installed AI CLI to use for translation

preferences.name: claudeModel
preferences.title: Claude Model
preferences.description: Model passed to `claude --model` (e.g. haiku, sonnet, opus). Leave empty for the CLI default.

preferences.name: codexModel
preferences.title: Codex Model
preferences.description: Model passed to `codex exec -m`. Leave empty for the CLI default.

preferences.name: geminiModel
preferences.title: Gemini Model
preferences.description: Model passed to `gemini -m` (e.g. gemini-2.5-flash). Leave empty for the CLI default.

preferences.name: copilotModel
preferences.title: Copilot Model
preferences.description: Model passed to `copilot --model`. Leave empty for the CLI default.

preferences.name: customCommand
preferences.title: Custom Command
preferences.description: Shell command used by the Custom Command provider. The full prompt is written to its stdin and stdout is used as the translation (e.g. `ollama run llama3.2`).

preferences.name: cliPath
preferences.title: CLI Path Override
preferences.description: Absolute path to the selected provider's executable. Leave empty to look it up from your login shell PATH.

preferences.name: extraArgs
preferences.title: Extra CLI Arguments
preferences.description: Additional arguments appended to the selected provider's command line.

preferences.name: defaultTargetLanguage
preferences.title: Default Target Language
preferences.description: Target language used the first time the command runs

preferences.name: secondTargetLanguage
preferences.title: Second Target Language
preferences.description: Used instead of the target language when the detected source language already equals the target (e.g. Chinese text while the target is Chinese)

preferences.name: autoTranslate
preferences.title: Translation
preferences.label: Translate automatically while typing
preferences.description: When disabled, press Enter (Translate action) to start a translation

preferences.name: debounceMs
preferences.title: Typing Delay (ms)
preferences.description: How long to wait after you stop typing before calling the CLI

preferences.name: useSelectedText
preferences.title: Initial Text
preferences.label: Use selected text when the command opens
preferences.description: Prefill the source text with the text selected in the frontmost app

preferences.name: timeoutSeconds
preferences.title: Timeout (seconds)
preferences.description: Abort the CLI process if it runs longer than this

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
